in_sanskrit.name: Jignasha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Desire for Knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jignasha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Jignasha means 'desire for knowledge' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the root word 'jigna' which means 'to know'. This name reflects a strong desire for knowledge and a thirst for wisdom. It is also associated with the moon, which represents the mind and the inner self.
